title: Review a Peer's Pull Request
objective: Give written code review feedback on someone else's real pull request that is specific, actionable, and professionally kind.
whyThisMatters: Reviewing code well is a distinct skill from writing it. Vague praise and vague criticism both waste a reviewee's time. Practicing feedback you'd be comfortable receiving yourself is as important as practicing receiving it.
evidence: A link to the reviewed PR with comments visible, or the written review text if commenting directly wasn't possible
A short self-review note classifying each comment as blocking, suggestion, or question, in one place
AI disclosure entry if AI helped draft review comments
acceptanceCriteria: At least 5 review comments exist on the actual PR, or as a written substitute, each tied to a specific line or section.
Each comment is labeled or clearly distinguishable as blocking, suggestion, or question.
At least one comment references a specific acceptance criterion, test, or behavior, not only style.
No comment is purely negative without a suggested alternative or a question inviting the author's reasoning.
